SUNLU PLA+ 2.0 HQ.notes: SUNLU TDS: 205-245 C (205-215 at 50-100 mm/s), bed 50-60, HDT 56, Vicat 54. Dry 45-50 C for 8-12 h (never 55).

SUNLU PLA Matte HQ.notes: SUNLU TDS: 205-245 C (205-215 at 50-100 mm/s), bed 50-60, density 1.31. Decorative or light-duty (39 MPa). Dry 50 C for 6-8 h.

SUNLU PETG 2.0 HQ.notes: SUNLU TDS: 230-270 C (230-240 at 50-100 mm/s), bed 70-80, density 1.22, HDT 71, retraction 0.8-1.2 mm. Glue as release agent on smooth PEI. Dry 65 C for 10-12 h, new spools too.

eSUN PETG HQ.notes: eSUN TDS v2.0: 230-260 C, bed 75-90, density 1.27, HDT 64. The TDS fan 100% is a test condition; moderate cooling here for layer bonding. Dry 60 C for 8-12 h.

SUNLU HS Matte PETG HQ.notes: SUNLU TDS 2026: 240-260 C, bed 60-70 on textured PEI, density 1.28, HDT 70. Calibrate flow and pressure advance (older PETG community values do not apply). Prefer PETG 2.0 or eSUN for strength-critical parts. Dry 60-65 C for 6-8 h, store below 20 % RH.

CC3D HIPS HQ.notes: CC3D: 240-260 C, bed about 100, enclosure required. Density set to typical HIPS 1.04. Breakaway interface for ASA at 0 mm gap; drop toward 245 C if it fuses to ASA. Dry 60-65 C only if exposed.

Anycubic ASA HQ.notes: Anycubic TDS V3.0: 255-275 C (new spec 260-280), bed 80-100 with glue, density 1.07 (1.09 new spec). Dry 70-80 C for 8-12 h.

SUNLU ASA HQ.notes: SUNLU TDS: 250-260 C at 50-100 mm/s, 260-280 at 100-200, bed 90-110 (thin glue on textured PEI), density 1.04, HDT 101. Dry 80 C for 8 h.

SUNLU TPU 95A HQ.notes: SUNLU TDS: 190-230 C, bed 50-60, density 1.21, retraction 0.8-1.2 mm. Engineering plate 35 C with glue. Dry 50-60 C for 6-12 h.
